repost_rule: From 2026-10-15 onward: post 3 pins per day. Slot 1 is ALWAYS a priority pin (priority=true: Christmas, 2027, Bundle), rotating through the priority items in repost_pool in order (index n mod 6, n = days since 2026-10-15). Slots 2-3: the non-priority items of repost_pool, cycling in order (items 2n and 2n+1 mod count). Use each item's own link (product page when given). Always write a NEW keyword-rich English title (max 100 chars) and a new description with 3-5 search keywords + 5 hashtags; never reuse an earlier title. After 2026-12-24 Christmas pins stop being priority: use 2027 and Bundle only for slot 1.
